title: Molecular Docking of Natural Compounds for Potential Inhibition of AhR.
authors: Giordano, Deborah; Facchiano, Angelo; Moccia, Stefania; Meola, Anna Maria Iole; Russo, Gian Luigi; Spagnuolo, Carmela
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接研究天然化合物对AhR转录因子的抑制，涉及蛋白-蛋白异二聚化与DNA结合上游机制，但非直接TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: The aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) is a highly conserved environmental sensor, historically known for mediating the toxicity of xenobiotics. It is involved in numerous cellular processes such as differentiation, proliferation, immunity, inflammation, homeostasis, and metabolism. It exerts a central role in several conditions such as cancer, inflammation, and aging, acting as a transcription factor belonging to the basic helix-loop-helix/Per-ARNT-Sim (bHLH-PAS) protein family. A key step in the canonical AhR activation is AhR-ARNT heterodimerization followed by the binding to the xenobiotic-responsive elements (XREs). The present work aims to investigate the potential AhR inhibitory activity of selected natural compounds. Due to the absence of a complete structure of human AhRs, a model consisting of the bHLH, the PAS A, and the PAS B domains was constructed. Blind and focused docking simulations revealed the presence of further binding pockets, different from the canonical one presented in the PAS B domain, which could be important for AhR inhibition due to the possibility to impede AhR:ARNT heterodimerization, either preventing conformational changes or masking crucial sites necessary for protein-protein interaction. Two of the compounds retrieved from the docking simulations, i.e., beta-carotene and ellagic acid, confirmed their capacity of inhibiting benzo[a]pyrene (BaP)-induced AhR activation in in vitro tests on the human hepatoma cell line HepG2, validating the efficacy of the computational approach.
abstract_zh: 芳香烃受体（aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AhR）是一种高度保守的环境传感器，历史上以介导外源物质的毒性而闻名。它参与多种细胞过程，如分化、增殖、免疫、炎症、稳态和代谢。作为碱性螺旋-环-螺旋/Per-ARNT-Sim（bHLH-PAS）蛋白家族的一员，AhR在癌症、炎症和衰老等多种疾病中发挥核心作用，充当转录因子。AhR经典激活的关键步骤是AhR-ARNT异二聚化，随后与异源物质响应元件（xenobiotic-responsive elements, XREs）结合。本研究旨在探讨所选天然化合物潜在的AhR抑制活性。由于缺乏完整的人源AhR结构，构建了一个包含bHLH、PAS A和PAS B结构域的模型。盲对接和聚焦对接模拟揭示了除PAS B结构域中经典结合位点外还存在其他结合口袋，这些口袋可能通过阻碍AhR:ARNT异二聚化（无论是阻止构象变化还是掩盖蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用所需的关键位点）对AhR抑制具有重要意义。从对接模拟中获得的两种化合物，即β-胡萝卜素和鞣花酸，在人类肝癌细胞系HepG2的体外实验中证实了其抑制苯并[a]芘（benzo[a]pyrene, BaP）诱导的AhR激活的能力，从而验证了计算方法的有效性。
